limitations: One deterministic intervention case; not population evidence or an unbiased random sample.
Two forecast arms share a belief; reactive intentionally has no future belief.
30-minute notice-calendar ticks map to one-second packet simulation ticks.
No rejected proposal is inferred when it is absent from the archived record.
Different historical controller code versions are identified by their registered contracts.
Original run preservation is unchanged; this is a reconstructible derived asset, not a new historical-run backup.
selection_rule: From common 2-Mbps worlds in lexicographic world-ID order, choose the first successful complete triple with identical event, initial observation, seed and native binary, identical 7B beliefs in the two predictive arms, no reactive belief, and a recorded lookahead goal intervention. Scores, wins and performance gaps are not selection criteria.
